metadata.scope: DOH FY 2027 Health Facilities Enhancement Program (HFEP) annex; not the entire DOH appropriation. The I-A HFEP allocation of PHP 10,088,832,000 additionally includes PHP 67,173,000 MOOE, which is outside this annex.
metadata.ids: source-artifact-local page and band identifiers; not cross-document facility identities

agency_check.label: Health Facilities Enhancement Program
agency_check.note: The I-A row shows the wider HFEP allocation: MOOE plus the annex's capital outlays. The annex total must match only the capital-outlay component.

source_evidence.method: native ruled bands, bold control rows, four amount columns

reading_comparison.method: page.get_text() equality over PDF 877-893 of both I-B copies
reading_comparison.note: Textual identity does not authenticate the legislative stage of either supplied copy.
